coordinateSystem.units: logical pixels after uniform assembly scale
coordinateSystem.timelineProgress: For job-driven tracks use clamp(job.progress, 0, 1), independently for each actual work-head slot. For event feedback use normalized visual elapsed time only.

bindingReferences.jobView: src/core.js view stations[].jobs[]: amount, progress, complete
bindingReferences.note: These are observed existing fields and events, not new APIs implemented by this artwork delivery. Integrator must use the actual dispatch flow and consume each emitted event once.

invariants: No visual track produces or consumes game inventory, coins, sales or jobs.
Draw portions from each job.amount captured when that job starts; upgrading batchSize never changes an existing job's visible portions.
Each installed head reads its own job; one blocked head must not freeze or complete its siblings.
An empty head has no product creation or looping processing effect. A completed blocked job holds its finished product without replaying completion effects.
Expansion preserves installed heads. Empty new slots remain covered until a real equipment purchase installs a head.
A ship effect consumes only a real positive ship event and displays only that event's already-settled coins. The animation never issues a second reward.
Textures, source files and UI example numbers are independent. Prices, counts, grades, progress and labels are runtime text.
Reduced motion changes visual displacement only; jobs and settlement retain the same timing and amount.

effects.name: 爆锅
effects.trigger: A real job exists in this installed head, job.amount > 0 and !job.complete
effects.duration: actual job duration; no fixed artificial cycle

timeline.pose: Work head settles toward operating position by up to 3 px; product stays within kettle content clip.
Head shifts at most 1.5 px relative to its own pivot; reveal a bounded popcorn representation using actual progress and this job.amount.
Settle completed popcorn at output pose; at most one steam patch per head rises up to 8 px and fades without obscuring product.

effects.completion: At complete=true hold the finished job amount. Transfer out of the machine only when the authoritative job leaves its slot and downstream inventory reflects transfer.
effects.blocked: Hold completed kettle/output product; steam processing emission stops.
effects.idle: Rest head, no popping or product emission.
effects.reducedMotion: Keep clip/progress and final pose; remove shake and rising steam.

effects.name: 落料装杯
effects.trigger: A real cup job has consumed a sufficient upstream batch
effects.duration: actual job duration; no synthetic filling after job removal

timeline.pose: Place an empty cup at the slot target; lower the independent head within its reviewed assembly travel.
Raise product_cup_fill from empty to full through the cup-mouth clip. Up to two representative kernels can move along the nozzle-to-cup path, only for active processing.
Return head to neutral; keep the filled cup behind the front guard. A dual-portion job uses the matching two-cup arrangement.

effects.completion: Retain the completed cup(s) until actual downstream transfer; do not create an extra cup sprite on replay.
effects.blocked: Filled cup remains visible; nozzle and falling kernels stop.
effects.idle: Empty/rest pose with no falling kernels. A partially stocked upstream buffer below batch requirement does not start filling.
effects.reducedMotion: Keep continuous fill clipping; omit nozzle travel and falling kernels.

effects.name: 包装
effects.driver: each active ship job.progress before settlement
effects.trigger: A real ship job contains accepted cup portions

timeline.pose: Place this job.amount of represented filled cups into the reviewed single, dual-tray or box fixture. For boxes compose open back/body, cup contents, then product_box_front; the entire package remains behind the machine front guard.
Move the individual packaging head down by at most 6 px. For amount >= 4, lower the separate box lid along its assembly path; no new portions appear.
Head returns; single cup, dual tray or closed box holds at output anchor.

effects.completion: Packaging produces no portions or coins; wait for the authoritative ship event for departure feedback.
effects.blocked: Hold completed package if a future output hold is exposed; do not infer shipping from pose completion.
effects.idle: Rest head with no fabricated package.
effects.reducedMotion: Switch through open and completed package poses without press displacement.

effects.name: 自动出货
effects.driver: real ship events followed by presentation-only elapsed time

timeline.pose: Use the actual shipped package group at the machine output anchor; record event.amount and event.coins in a bounded visual aggregate.
Move representative product toward the outbound scene edge along the reviewed conveyor axis by up to 42 px; display one independent +coins text receipt using the summed actual event coins.
Fade departed product and coin receipt to zero, then remove presentation objects.

aggregation.rule: Accumulate events while the visual channel is busy. Show bounded representative geometry while preserving summed text values. No dropped event is replayed into settlement.

effects.idle: No ship event means no departure or income animation.
effects.reducedMotion: Keep one short static receipt for 500 ms; skip movement.

effects.name: 安装成功
effects.driver: real upgrade event followed by presentation-only elapsed time

timeline.pose: Keep the purchased station selected; tint its ground marker and show the installed confirmation strip.
At most three separate sparkle patches scale from 0.85 to 1.05 and fade around the changed slot; never overlap a price or readout.
Remove sparkles; retain the confirmation strip and its independent review-next action.

effects.completion: Preserve in-flight old job.amount and head progress; existing jobs do not restart. Only purchased newly installed head slots become visible.
notTriggeredBy: repeated click on old purchase target
effects.reducedMotion: Show check icon and confirmation strip, omit sparkle scaling.

effects.name: 扩建
effects.driver: real evolve event followed by presentation-only elapsed time
effects.trigger: event.type === 'evolve' after a successful expansion commit

timeline.pose: Show the new generation and actual capacity labels as independent text; retain all existing active job positions.
Fade in only generation-specific chassis or storage extensions, and empty-slot covers; use at most four sparkle patches around the two buffers.
Settle the expanded assembly; show that upgrades are available for separate purchase.

effects.completion: Do not add heads, processing throughput, stock or coins beyond the authoritative expansion state. Gen-6 completion uses a label/check icon without invented rewards.
effects.reducedMotion: Apply final chassis/capacity state directly and show a static confirmation.

globalVisualLimits.stockRendering: At high capacity use clipped aggregate layers. Even 1 portion must remain visible. These are proposed presentation budgets, not runtime measurements.

staticReviewRequirements: Show idle, processing and complete-wait poses with unchanged assets.
Check product behind foreground guards and inside mouth/bin clips.
Check old smaller batches beside new larger batches without rewriting amount.
Check concurrent mixed head states through independent per-slot poses.
Check zero ship events yields no income receipt.
Check multiple ship events aggregate exact amount and coins once.
Document reduced-motion poses and finite effect lifetimes.
